info.title: Biomedical Research Navigator API
info.summary: Workspace-oriented clinical and molecular exploration API.
info.description: Biomedical Research Navigator exposes a browser-facing API for multi-dataset workspace selection, clinical query and analysis, saved cohorts, and Pheno-Ranker execution over sample-level data.

get.description: Serves the Biomedical Research Navigator HTML shell with the current branding and authenticated user context.
Returns patient-level summaries for the active dataset or workspace scope.
Returns the normalized clinical context for a single patient identifier.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Patients  Patient Id  Get

get.description: Returns the timeline-oriented patient workspace payload used by the patient detail view.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Workspace Patients  Patient Id  Navigator Get

get.description: Returns medication counts derived from the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Get Medication Counts Cohorts Medications Get

get.description: Returns disease counts derived from the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Get Disease Counts Cohorts Diseases Get

get.description: Returns the deterministic medication-matched workspace subset for a single medication label.

schema.title: Response Search Medication Cohort Cohorts Medications Search Get

get.summary: Run a simple GET workspace query
get.description: Executes a lightweight workspace query using query-string parameters. Prefer POST /query for full prompt history and planner mode control.

post.description: Executes a deterministic and/or LLM-assisted natural-language query against the active workspace.

schema.title: Response Query App Post Query Post

get.description: Returns whether LM Studio is enabled plus the current model and base URL.
Returns the current local-auth session state and visible user identity.

post.description: Authenticates a local user and creates a session-backed login.
Clears the local session for the current user.

get.description: Returns local-auth diagnostics useful during development and deployment troubleshooting.
Returns local users and groups. When auth is enabled, this endpoint is admin-only.
Returns datasets visible to the current user plus the currently active workspace selection.

post.description: Creates a new dataset registry entry. Admin-only.
Applies one or more authorized dataset IDs as the current workspace for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates dataset metadata, visibility, or access policy. Admin-only.

get.description: Returns the current instance branding logo file if one is configured.
Returns saved cohorts for the current user within the active dataset workspace.

post.description: Persists a saved cohort containing canonical sample IDs and derived patient IDs.

delete.description: Deletes a saved cohort owned by the current user.

post.description: Executes clinical or molecular analysis over the active workspace or selected saved cohorts.

get.description: Returns transcriptomic datasets visible in the current workspace.

get.summary: Search genes in a molecular dataset
get.description: Returns gene identifiers for a selected molecular dataset with optional search and limit filtering.

schema.title: Response Get Molecular Genes Molecular Genes Get

post.description: Returns scoped gene expression summaries for one molecular dataset, optionally comparing cohort A and cohort B.

get.description: Returns persisted analysis sessions for the current user.

schema.title: Response Get Analysis Sessions Analysis Sessions Get

post.summary: Create or update an analysis session
post.description: Persists analysis session state, including prompt draft, scopes, and prior turns.

schema.title: Response Update Analysis Session Title Analysis Sessions  Session Id  Patch

delete.description: Deletes a saved analysis session for the current user.

post.description: Runs Pheno-Ranker for the active workspace using either patient mode or cohort mode.

post.description: Converts a natural-language request into a normalized Pheno-Ranker execution plan.
